name: Hamilton Gardens
hours: 主题围园每天 10:00–18:00（最后入园 17:30，圣诞节闭园）；外围花园、Turtle Lake 与游乐场免费开放
price: 外围花园免费；主题围园：16 岁以下免费，Hamilton 居民持 MyGardens Pass 免费，非本市居民/国际游客成人 NZ$27.50
description: 一圈一圈走进不同国家风格的主题花园，外围草坪和游乐场适合孩子放电。
photoAlt: 汉密尔顿花园超现实主义花园里的巨型手推车

en.description: Wander through themed gardens from different countries; the outer lawns and playground are great for kids to burn off energy.
en.hours: Enclosed themed gardens daily 10:00–18:00 (last entry 17:30, closed Christmas Day); outer gardens, Turtle Lake and playground are free
en.price: Outer gardens free; themed gardens: under 16 free, Hamilton residents free with MyGardens Pass, non-resident/international adults NZ$27.50
en.photoAlt: Giant wheelbarrow in the Surrealist Garden at Hamilton Gardens

name: Hamilton Zoo
description: 沿着林间步道看长颈鹿、老虎和本土鸟类，大半天的亲子行程。
photoAlt: 汉密尔顿动物园里正在吃干草的两只斑马

en.description: Follow bush walkways to see giraffes, tigers and native birds — a good half-day family outing.
en.hours: Daily 9:30–16:30 (last entry 15:30, closed Christmas Day)
en.price: Adult NZ$27.50; child (3–15) NZ$14; under 3 free; family NZ$80 (2 adults + 3–4 children) (from 2026-10-01)
en.photoAlt: Two zebras eating hay at Hamilton Zoo

name: Te Whare Taonga o Waikato Museum & Gallery
zh: 怀卡托博物馆与美术馆
price: 常设展免费（欢迎捐款）；Exscite 与部分特展、活动收费
description: 河边的城市博物馆，看毛利文化与本地历史，下雨天也能安排半天。
photoAlt: 怀卡托博物馆展厅内景

en.description: A riverside city museum with Māori culture and local history — an easy half day even when it rains.
en.hours: Daily 10:00–17:00 (closed 25 December)
en.price: Permanent exhibitions free (donations welcome); Exscite and some special exhibitions/events are charged
en.photoAlt: Inside a gallery at Waikato Museum

name: Hamilton Central Library – Te Koopuu Maania o Kirikiriroa
description: 市中心的公共图书馆，带孩子挑几本绘本，顺便看看有没有亲子活动。

en.description: The central public library — pick a few picture books with the kids and see if there are family sessions on.
en.hours: Mon–Wed & Fri 9:30–17:30; Thu 9:30–20:00; Sat & Sun 9:30–17:00 (public holidays may differ)
en.photoAlt: Exterior of Hamilton Central Library, New Zealand (photographed in 2011)

photoAlt: 新西兰汉密尔顿中央图书馆建筑外观（摄于2011年）

name: Magical Bridge Destination Playground
zh: Magical Bridge 无障碍游乐场
address: Claudelands Park, cnr Brooklyn Road & Heaphy Terrace, Claudelands
hours: 户外公共游乐场，开放时间待确认
description: 汉密尔顿首个全无障碍游乐场，有滑梯、秋千、旋转区和玩水区。

en.description: Hamilton's first fully accessible playground, with slides, swings, a spinning zone and water play.
en.hours: Outdoor public playground; opening hours to be confirmed

name: Hamilton Lake Domain (Rotoroa)
hours: 公共公园，开放时间待确认
description: 绕湖散步、骑车，湖边有大型彩色游乐场，适合一家人慢慢走。
photoAlt: 汉密尔顿湖（Rotoroa）湖面与岸边的鸭子
photoCredit: Emily Walker from Wellington, New Zealand

en.description: Walk or bike around the lake; there's a big colourful playground by the water for an easy family stroll.
en.hours: Public park; opening hours to be confirmed
en.photoAlt: Lake Rotoroa (Hamilton Lake) with ducks by the shore

name: Waiwhakareke Natural Heritage Park
hours: 公共公园，开放时间待确认
description: 动物园旁的生态修复公园，有适合幼儿的游乐场和湖边步道；园内不允许带狗。
photoAlt: Waiwhakareke 公园的马蹄湖与芦苇

en.description: An ecological restoration park next to the zoo, with a toddler-friendly playground and lakeside paths; no dogs allowed.
en.hours: Public park; opening hours to be confirmed
en.photoAlt: Horseshoe lake and reeds at Waiwhakareke park

name: Taitua Arboretum
hours: 开放时间待确认
description: 约 20 公顷的树林和草地，适合散步、野餐、找鸭子；狗需牵绳。

en.description: About 20 hectares of trees and lawns for walks, picnics and duck spotting; dogs on a lead.
en.hours: Opening hours to be confirmed

name: Waterworld
price: 成人 NZ$8.80；儿童（5–15 岁）NZ$5.00；5 岁以下由付费成人陪同下水免费
description: 市政游泳中心，雨天也能带孩子去玩水。

en.description: The city's aquatic centre — water fun for the kids even on rainy days.
en.price: Adult NZ$8.80; child (5–15) NZ$5.00; under 5 free with a paying adult in the water

name: Hakarimata Scenic Reserve
address: Brownlee Avenue / Waingaro Road access, Ngāruawāhia
hours: DOC 保护区，开放时间待确认；出发前查看 DOC 警示
description: 离市区不远的原生林步道，能看到大贝壳杉；选短线路更适合小朋友。
photoAlt: Hakarimata 保护区内的大贝壳杉

en.description: Native forest tracks not far from town with big kauri trees; shorter tracks suit little ones better.
en.hours: DOC reserve; opening hours to be confirmed; check DOC alerts before you go
en.photoAlt: Large kauri tree in Hakarimata reserve

name: Lake Te Koo Utu
hours: 公共公园，开放时间待确认
description: 剑桥镇的湖边公园，有分龄游乐场和约 1 公里的环湖步道。

en.description: A lakeside park in Cambridge with age-zoned playgrounds and a loop path of about 1 km.
en.hours: Public park; opening hours to be confirmed

name: Mighty River Domain, Lake Karāpiro
hours: 开放时间待确认；常有赛艇等大型活动
description: 著名的赛艇湖，湖边草地开阔，适合野餐看划船。

en.description: The famous rowing lake, with open lawns by the water — good for a picnic and watching the boats.
en.hours: Opening hours to be confirmed; large events such as rowing are often held here

name: Te Whare Taonga o Te Awamutu Museum
hours: 周一至周五 10:00–16:00；周六与公众假期 10:00–14:00；周日闭馆
description: 小镇博物馆，讲述 Waipā 一带的历史，适合短暂停留。

en.description: A small-town museum telling the history of the Waipā area — good for a short stop.
en.hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–16:00; Sat and public holidays 10:00–14:00; closed Sundays

name: Sanctuary Mountain Maungatautari
hours: 游客中心每天 9:00–16:00（最后入园 16:00，圣诞节闭园）
price: 需购票：官网 Explorer Day Pass 与导览价格请以官网为准（待确认）
description: 被防护围栏圈起来的山林，有机会听到、看到本土珍稀鸟类。
photoAlt: Maungatautari 生态保护区里的卡卡鹦鹉

en.description: A mountain forest inside a predator-proof fence, where you may hear and see rare native birds.
en.hours: Visitor centre daily 9:00–16:00 (last entry 16:00, closed Christmas Day)
en.price: Tickets required: see the official site for Explorer Day Pass and guided tour prices (to be confirmed)
en.photoAlt: A kākā at Maungatautari Ecological Island

name: Waireinga / Bridal Veil Falls
hours: DOC 步道，开放时间待确认
description: 走 10 分钟就能到瀑布顶的观景台，再往下 10 分钟到瀑布底。
photoAlt: Raglan 附近的 Bridal Veil 瀑布

en.description: A 10-minute walk to the viewing platform at the top of the falls, then another 10 minutes down to the base.
en.hours: DOC track; opening hours to be confirmed

name: Ngarunui Beach
hours: 全天开放（待确认）；救生员夏季值守，具体时间查 Safeswim
description: Raglan 的冲浪海滩，夏季有救生员巡逻；请只在旗帜之间游泳。
photoAlt: 夕阳下的 Ngarunui 海滩

en.description: Raglan's surf beach, patrolled by lifeguards in summer; only swim between the flags.
en.hours: Open all day (to be confirmed); lifeguards on duty in summer — check Safeswim for times

name: Ōtorohanga Kiwi House
price: 成人 NZ$29.50；儿童（5–15 岁）NZ$13.50；5 岁以下免费；家庭票 NZ$75（2 成人 + 3 儿童）
description: 在夜行馆里近距离看奇异鸟，还有本土鸟类园；门票一年内可再入一次。

en.description: See kiwi up close in the nocturnal house, plus a native bird park; tickets include one revisit within a year.
en.hours: Daily 9:00–17:00 (last entry 16:15, closed Christmas Day)
en.price: Adult NZ$29.50; child (5–15) NZ$13.50; under 5 free; family NZ$75 (2 adults + 3 children)
en.photoAlt: Entrance of the Ōtorohanga Kiwi House

name: Waitomo Glowworm Caves
hours: 每天有多场导览（具体场次见官网）
price: 成人约 NZ$85；儿童约 NZ$39；家庭票约 NZ$217（2 成人 + 2 儿童）（待官网确认）
description: 坐小船滑过满是萤火虫的洞穴，约 45 分钟导览，雨天也能成行。
photoAlt: Waitomo 萤火虫洞内的石灰岩洞穴

en.description: Glide by boat through a cave full of glowworms on a guided tour of about 45 minutes — fine on rainy days.
en.hours: Several guided tours daily (see the official site for times)
en.price: Adult about NZ$85; child about NZ$39; family about NZ$217 (2 adults + 2 children) (to be confirmed on the official site)

name: Hobbiton Movie Set
hours: 每天多场导览（具体场次见官网）
price: 成人（18+）NZ$130；10 岁及以下免费（须由付费成人陪同并分配票）；其他年龄段票价见官网
description: 走进电影里的霍比特人村庄，小屋和花园都很适合拍照。
photoAlt: 霍比屯电影片场的霍比特人小屋

en.description: Step into the hobbit village from the films — the little houses and gardens are great for photos.
en.hours: Several guided tours daily (see the official site for times)
en.price: Adult (18+) NZ$130; 10 and under free (must be accompanied by a paying adult with a ticket assigned); other age prices on the official site
en.photoAlt: A hobbit hole at the Hobbiton Movie Set

name: Wairere Falls Track
address: Goodwin Road, off Old Te Aroha Road, Okauia
hours: DOC 步道，开放时间待确认
description: 到瀑布底观景台单程约 45 分钟，登顶约 90 分钟，适合能走路的大孩子。
photoAlt: Kaimai 山林中的 Wairere 瀑布

en.description: About 45 minutes one way to the lookout at the base of the falls and about 90 minutes to the top — best for older kids who can walk.
en.hours: DOC track; opening hours to be confirmed
en.photoAlt: Wairere Falls in the Kaimai bush
